name: Stylized 3D presenter
description: A sculpted, clay-soft 3D person in a lived-in home studio at night: warm lamp light, cool window rim light, soft shadows, shallow focus. Talking-head explainers and personal stories.
rules: One person, one costume, the same room: the home studio never changes inside a story.
Faces are the performance: brows and eyelids move on every beat, the mouth follows the voice.
Shallow focus on the speaker; the room is soft but readable.
Warm practical light on the person, cool light from the window behind: never flat front light.
Dialogue captions sit top-centre in a dark pill with a speaker tag; keep them off the face (the face lives in the middle third).
No gore, no horror lighting; blown highlights only for a magic object and only briefly.
camera_language: Medium three-quarter and static while the person talks; over-the-shoulder for hands-on moments; push-ins only on a realisation or a reveal and always with a stated reason. Focus follows the speaker; practical lights (lamp, monitor) are motivated, the window gives a cool rim.
audio_direction: calm bed, keyboard type sounds, soft pop on helper reactions
pitfalls: A strong glow near the lens whites out the frame: keep emissive objects below 0.6 and bloom threshold above 0.9 in close inserts.
Hair reads as a helmet in extreme close-ups: stay at close-up or wider.
Over-the-shoulder needs the camera back 1.9 m and 0.8 m to the side or the actor's back fills the frame.
